face-api.js (vendored browser bundle)
=====================================

Package:  @vladmandic/face-api 1.7.15
Upstream: https://github.com/vladmandic/face-api
License:  MIT

Files:
  face-api.js                      UMD browser build (tfjs bundled)
  models/tiny_face_detector_model-weights_manifest.json
  models/tiny_face_detector_model.bin
  models/face_expression_model-weights_manifest.json
  models/face_expression_model.bin

The live camera view loads these files from this folder only. All inference
runs in the browser tab; frames are never uploaded to the API or stored.
